mapper.select: SELECT STATS_JSON AS "statsJson" ,RESULT_JSON AS "resultJson" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_MOCK_DIAGNOSIS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_DIAGNOSIS WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MOCK_DIAGNOSIS (USER_ID, STATS_JSON, RESULT_JSON) VALUES (#{userId}, #{statsJson}, #{resultJson})
